method: Mounted real useSoloCombatPersistence with StrictMode; API boundary is deferred/mocked. Canonical finalize/turn-state/inventory serialization and command ID generator are real. Initial red code is a mechanical move of the existing page callbacks before adding session guards.
unchanged: Accepted server writes are not cancelled or undone
No automatic resend or extra command ID
Current-route single/party accepted revisions and reset behavior
Saved payload/RNG and original input are unchanged by inspection
limits: Unit lifecycle proof does not replace the fresh common browser/real API suite.
Publication guard preserves current-session UI ownership; it does not change server authorization or transaction semantics.
